seo.description: Bid leveling for general contractors: reads every sub proposal into one sheet, traces each number to its page and flags scope no bidder carried.
faq: Do subs have to use a portal?
No. It reads proposals as they arrive today, in PDF, spreadsheet or email.
Does it pick the winning bid?
No. It lines up scope and price so the estimator can compare. The award decision stays with your team.
Does it work with our estimating software?
It is built around your existing tools. The leveled sheet can be exported or written where your team already works.
